title: Towards Algorithmic Fidelity: Mental Health Representation across Demographics in Synthetic vs. Human-generated Data

bias_targets.methodology: Semantic analysis using Structural Topic Modeling (STM) and lexical analysis using LIWC dictionaries with log-odds-ratio to compare the prevalence of depression-triggering stressors and specific word usage generated by GPT-3 for men versus women.

Semantic analysis using Structural Topic Modeling (STM) and lexical analysis using LIWC dictionaries with log-odds-ratio to compare the prevalence of depression-triggering stressors and specific word usage generated by GPT-3 across Asian, African American, Hispanic, and White demographic groups, as well as intersectional groups (e.g., African American women vs. men).
